text_steel.sample: How should agent actions be approved?

text_steel_2.sample: Every write, delete and command asks for approval, every time. Reads run freely.

text_steel_3.sample: Reads run freely. Writes and commands ask; you can allow a kind of action for the rest of the run. Deletes and protected paths always ask.

text_steel_4.sample: Reads and normal writes inside the workspace run freely. Commands run confined to the workspace and ask first. Sensitive or protected paths ask.

text_steel_5.sample: No gating. Every operation runs immediately, commands run unconfined.
